about: Reusable callback lines, recorded once per tutor and used by any explainer's recall section through {"use": "<tutor>.<key>"}. Keys: own.watched and own.not-watched for the tutor's own earlier explainer; <other tutor>.watched and <other tutor>.not-watched for someone else's; short-version leads into a 20-second short version; after points the player back to the full lesson. No line names a topic or an explainer, so the game shows the prerequisite's title card while the line plays. Every tutor is provisional (GitHub #18), so nothing here is recorded yet. See README.md, 'Callback lines'.
